message.content:
No, I don’t want the software to pick the drone for me. It’s my job to decide which drone flies, and I need to be responsible for that choice. The software can help me find out which drones are available and could reach the job, but it can’t make the final decision for me.

If the software picked the drone, I wouldn’t know why it chose that one, and I wouldn’t be able to take responsibility if something went wrong. It’s got to be my call.
